observation_summary: The application throws a NullPointerException when attempting to remove a marker from a plot that has no markers associated with the specified index.
reasoning_summary: The code attempts to retrieve a list of markers from a Map using a specific index. If no markers have been added for that index, the Map returns null. The code then proceeds to call the .remove() method on this null reference, resulting in a NullPointerException. The fix introduces a null check to verify if the retrieved list exists before attempting to perform operations on it, returning false if the list is null.
